title: VSZAPOWER Compliance & Test Documentation
description: VSZAPOWER model-specific battery documentation requests and charger EMC and RoHS test summaries, including report numbers, laboratories, dates and scope.
lead: VSZAPOWER is a rechargeable coin cell battery and charger brand operated by Shenzhen Weizan Technology Co., Ltd., specializing in rechargeable coin cells, charging solutions, OEM/ODM and private-label supply. This center lists EMC and RoHS evidence for three charger designs and documentation requests for five rechargeable coin cells. Match the model and version, then use the form to request original documents.

batteryText: For LIR2032, LIR2016, LIR2025, LIR2450 and ML2032, specify nominal voltage, capacity, product version and destination market. The team must confirm document availability and scope for the selected version.
batterySafety: ML2032 requires its own charging specification. Do not assume an LIR charging profile is suitable. Standard CR primary cells must not be recharged.
scope: Results apply to the submitted sample, tested materials and listed methods. They are not blanket certification for every product or market. Transport documentation also depends on the battery, packaging and shipment configuration.
